question: Which of the following is called the cyclic arrangement of time units in Hindustani Classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tala** is the term used for the **cyclic arrangement of time units in Hindustani Classical music**.
 
• It serves as the rhythmic framework for a musical composition, helping musicians maintain the tempo and structure of the piece.
 
• There are various types of Tala, each with its own specific number of beats and patt
